nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set from msg.sender in the constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address written by transferOwnership (onlyOwner) and consumed/reset in acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set to 'DWYN' in the DwayneToken constructor.
Public token name string, set to 'DWAYNE' in the DwayneToken constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 18 in the DwayneToken constructor.
Total token supply, assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of holder address to token balance; the primary asset ledger mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Overflow-checked addition helper used for crediting balances.
Underflow-checked subtraction helper used for debiting balances and allowances.
Overflow-checked multiplication helper (unused by the token logic).
Division helper with zero-divisor guard (unused by the token logic).
Owned constructor that assigns the deployer (msg.sender) as owner.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Two-step ownership acceptance; requires msg.sender == newOwner then writes owner and clears newOwner.
Token constructor that sets metadata, mints the entire supply to a hardcoded address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant function returning the balance of the supplied tokenOwner.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to the supplied amount and emits Approval.
Spends the caller allowance to move tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance then makes an external callback into the spender contract via receiveApproval.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, blocking plain ether transfers.
onlyOwner rescue that performs an external transfer call on an arbitrary token contract.
Caller-supplied address used as the initial owner in the Owned constructor.
Caller-supplied address compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier and in acceptOwnership.
Caller-supplied address used as the debited account in transfer/approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall.
External call to an attacker-chosen spender contract with attacker-controlled data; state (allowed) is written before the call, enabling reentrancy.
External call to an arbitrary tokenAddress contract gated only by the onlyOwner modifier.
Balance debit of msg.sender by a user-supplied token amount; arithmetically guarded by SafeMath.safeSub.
Allowance debit of allowed[from][msg.sender] by a user-supplied token amount; guarded by SafeMath.safeSub.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Token amount parameter of transfer, fully user controlled.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Source account parameter of transferFrom.

Token amount parameter of transferFrom.

Allowance amount parameter of approveAndCall.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the spender contract in approveAndCall.
Arbitrary target contract address for the rescue external call.
Amount passed to the arbitrary token contract transfer call.
Candidate new owner address accepted by transferOwnership.
Address whose balance is queried.
Allowance owner address queried by allowance().
Allowance spender address queried by allowance().
First operand of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Second operand of SafeMath.safeAdd.
Minuend operand of SafeMath.safeSub.
Subtrahend operand of SafeMath.safeSub.
First operand of SafeMath.safeMul.
Second operand of SafeMath.safeMul.
Numerator operand of SafeMath.safeDiv.
Denominator operand of SafeMath.safeDiv.
Named return variable holding the sum computed in safeAdd.
Named return variable holding the difference computed in safeSub.
Named return variable holding the product computed in safeMul.
Named return variable holding the quotient computed in safeDiv.
Named return variable of balanceOf.
Named return variable of transfer, always true on success.
Named return variable of approve, always true on success.
Named return variable of transferFrom, always true on success.
Named return variable of allowance.
Named return variable of approveAndCall.
Named return variable of transferAnyERC20Token, forwarding the external call result.

edges.reason: msg.sender from the deployer is used to initialize ownership inside the Owned constructor.
Owned constructor writes the caller-controlled msg.sender into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership by comparing msg.sender to owner.
Only the owner can stage a new owner by writing newOwner.
The privileged newOwner value originates from the transferOwnership argument.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner before changing ownership.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the privileged owner variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
transfer debits and authorizes on behalf of the caller's own account (msg.sender).
Recipient address flows from the transfer parameter into the balance update.
User-supplied token amount flows into the balance update logic of transfer.
transfer reads the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
transfer writes updated balances back into the balances mapping.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer performs the sender-balance subtraction attributable to a user-supplied amount.
The user-controlled tokens argument determines the size of the balance subtraction.
Result of the guarded subtraction is stored back into the sender's balance slot.
transfer produces the boolean success return value.
approve grants an allowance from the caller's own account (msg.sender).
Spender address parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
Allowance amount parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve produces the boolean success return value.
transferFrom consumes the allowance keyed by msg.sender as spender.
Source account parameter drives the debit in transferFrom.
Destination account parameter drives the credit in transferFrom.
Amount parameter drives both the balance and allowance updates.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping of source and destination.
transferFrom mutates the caller allowance in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom performs an allowance subtraction on caller-supplied data.
User-controlled tokens parameter sets the size of the allowance subtraction.
Reduced allowance value is written back into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom relies on SafeMath.safeSub for its debit operations.
transferFrom relies on SafeMath.safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom produces the boolean success return value.
approveAndCall sets an allowance from the caller's own account (msg.sender).
Spender address parameter is both the allowance key and the callback target.
Amount parameter is stored as the allowance before the external call.
Arbitrary data parameter is forwarded to the external contract.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before making the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into a caller-supplied contract after mutating allowance state.
The attacker-chosen spender address determines which contract is called back.
The callee can re-enter DwayneToken (e.g. transferFrom/approve) while approveAndCall state is fresh.
approveAndCall returns a boolean success flag after the callback.
onlyOwner restricts the arbitrary external call in transferAnyERC20Token.
The owner supplies the arbitrary contract address that will be called.
Owner-supplied amount is forwarded to the external token transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token delegates execution to an external ERC20 contract.
The arbitrary tokenAddress parameter controls the target of the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards the external call result as its return value.
balanceOf answers with the balance of the supplied address.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns the named balance variable.
allowance uses the tokenOwner parameter as the first mapping key.
allowance uses the spender parameter as the second mapping key.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
allowance returns the named remaining variable.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
Token constructor sets the symbol.
Token constructor sets the name.
Token constructor sets the decimals.
Token constructor mints the initial total supply.
Token constructor assigns the whole supply to a hardcoded holder address.
First operand feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
Second operand feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
safeAdd writes its computed sum into the return variable c.
Minuend feeds the subtraction inside safeSub.
Subtrahend feeds the subtraction and require check inside safeSub.
safeSub writes its computed difference into the return variable c.
First operand feeds the multiplication inside safeMul.
Second operand feeds the multiplication inside safeMul.
safeMul writes its computed product into the return variable c.
Numerator feeds the division inside safeDiv.
Denominator feeds the require and division inside safeDiv.
safeDiv writes its computed quotient into the return variable c.

normalization_plan.reason: Local parameter of transfer with no independent security identity; folded into the transfer core function.
User-supplied amount parameter that only matters through the transfer balance update.
Parameter of approve; only meaningful as the allowance mapping key within that function.
Parameter of approve; subsumed by the approve allowance write.
Source-account parameter used only inside transferFrom logic.

Amount parameter consumed by the transferFrom balance and allowance updates.
Spender address is the allowance key and the forced callback target; folded into approveAndCall.
Allowance amount parameter subsumed by the approveAndCall allowance write.
Arbitrary calldata is only relevant as payload of the unsafe external receiveApproval call.
Candidate owner parameter is meaningful only as the value staged by transferOwnership.
Query parameter that is fully subsumed by the balanceOf read.
First lookup key of allowance; not an independent security entity.
Second lookup key of allowance; not an independent security entity.

Operand local to safeAdd and fully absorbed by that helper function.

Operand local to safeDiv and fully absorbed by that helper function.
Operand local to safeDiv and fully absorbed by that helper function.
Return variable of safeAdd; no standalone semantic value.
Return variable of safeSub; no standalone semantic value.
Return variable of safeMul; no standalone semantic value.
Return variable of safeDiv; no standalone semantic value.
Return-value local of balanceOf, merged into the balanceOf function.
Boolean return local of transfer, merged into the transfer function.
Boolean return local of approve, merged into the approve function.
Boolean return local of transferFrom, merged into the transferFrom function.
Return-value local of allowance, merged into the allowance function.
Return local produced after the unsafe external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
